duration.$description: Brief §6.2, exactly these five. Tuned once at the Foundations milestone, then frozen; a change needs an ADR (ADR 0005).

instant.$description: Colour, background and border changes on hover.

fast.$description: Small state changes; exits of popovers and tooltips; the switch thumb.

normal.$description: Menus, popovers and tooltips entering; accordion; tabs indicator.

slower.$description: Page transitions and large layout changes.

spring.$description: Switch thumb and toast only. A damped spring (damping ratio 0.65, about 7% overshoot, settled at the end), emitted as CSS linear() from the stops in $extensions. DTCG 2025.10 has no linear() easing; the cubic-bezier value is the fallback for tools that ignore the extension.

enter.$description: Initial scale of popping elements: menus, popovers, dialogs.

timing.$description: Timings of the motion catalog (brief §6.3) that are not transition durations: delays, holds and the periods of looping animations.

tooltip-delay.$description: A tooltip appears after this hover or focus time; it hides without delay.

spinner-delay.$description: A spinner appears only after this much waiting.

spinner-min-visible.$description: Once shown, a spinner stays at least this long, so it never flashes.

stagger.$description: Delay between list items entering, for the first five items at most.

shimmer-period.$description: One sweep of the skeleton shimmer, linear, infinite.

slide.$description: How long a part of a control slides to show its new state: the switch thumb, and later the tabs indicator, on easing.spring or easing.standard. The same 120ms as duration.fast; 0ms under reduced motion, where the part jumps (ADR 0045).
